answer: New identities stake a 60,000 POA bond into the basalt foundation of the atlas registry, a public map of every agent's verified work. A falcon patrol of random peers spot-checks each newcomer: every falcon re-runs one claimed job and reports to the atlas within one epoch. A failed check burns the bond, half to the reporting falcon, the identity is banned 12 epochs and its atlas entry is struck. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60,000 = 60,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 60,000 POA bond once. The limit: falcon patrols can be gamed if auditors collude with the agents they check.
